# hfaudit

> CLI that scans Python source for Hugging Face Hub model/dataset IDs (from_pretrained, pipeline, load_dataset, hf_hub_download, snapshot_download) and checks each one against the public Hub API, flagging IDs that don't exist and namespaces suspiciously close to a well-known org.

Use this when code loads a model or dataset by ID from the Hugging
Face Hub — directly, or via an AI coding assistant's suggestion — and
you want to confirm the ID is real before running it. An LLM can
hallucinate a plausible-looking Hub ID the same way it hallucinates a
PyPI/npm package name; an attacker can register the hallucinated name,
or a name one edit away from a popular org, ahead of time. hfaudit
makes a live, unauthenticated call to the Hub's public metadata API
per ID, so it reports a real existence check, not a guess.

## Install
- [go install](https://github.com/experimental-gains/hfaudit#install): `go install github.com/experimental-gains/hfaudit@latest` (no registry signup, works with a plain `go install`)

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/experimental-gains/hfaudit/blob/main/README.md): full status list, exit codes, and example output
- [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/experimental-gains/hfaudit): generated Go API docs

## Related
- [slopcheck](https://github.com/experimental-gains/slopcheck): same check, PyPI/npm dependency names
- [modslop](https://github.com/experimental-gains/modslop): same check, Go module paths in go.mod
- [goproxycheck](https://github.com/experimental-gains/goproxycheck): diagnoses Go module proxy/sumdb fetch failures
- [goprivaudit](https://github.com/experimental-gains/goprivaudit): audits GOPRIVATE/GONOSUMDB config for sumdb leaks

## Repo
- [Source](https://github.com/experimental-gains/hfaudit): MIT-licensed, zero dependencies
